title: VLM-VPI: A Vision–Language Reasoning Framework for Improving Automated Vehicle–Pedestrian Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Stratifying simulated and real-world pedestrian interaction scenarios by age groups (children, adults, and seniors) and evaluating autonomous vehicle safety and performance metrics, such as Time-to-Collision (TTC), conflict event rates, and false negative rates, across these demographics to compare uniform control strategies against age-adaptive control.
